name: Black Widow (Deadly Origin)

abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Reduce Defensive AA: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Counter-Attack Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Sabotage: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen miktarda azaltır; rakibin savunma yetenekleri tetiklenemediğinde doğrudan hasar verir.

signatureAbility:
Red Room Training
Increase the potency of Sabotage Debuffs, increasing Direct damage done when abilities fail to trigger by [40 - 120%].
Increase the duration of Sabotage Debuffs by [10 - 80%].
Landing hits while Widow's Insight is active pauses Sabotage Debuffs for 0.5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Baton Hits deal Energy Damage instead of Physical and have a 40% chance to inflict a Shock Debuff dealing [7,919.25] Energy Damage for 3.65 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Widow's Insight - Max 50 Stacks:
content: Black Widow's covert assassin training kicks in whenever the perfect opportunity to strike presents itself. Gain Widow's Insight for 0.85 seconds whenever the Opponent is dashing forward or recovering from a Heavy, Special, or Combo ending Attack.
This ability refreshes its duration when successfully landing hits.
Widow's Insight is not affected by Ability Accuracy.

abilitySections.title: While Widow's Insight is Active
content: Light Hits: Increase Shock Ability Accuracy by a flat 60%.
Medium Hits: Reduce Defensive Ability Accuracy by 70%.
Heavy Hits: 100% chance to inflict a Stun Debuff for 1.75 seconds.
Ending a Combo has 100% chance to grant a Precision Buff increasing Critical Rating by [375] for 24 seconds. Max 8 Stacks.

abilitySections.title: Counter-Attack Evade
content: When caused to Miss, gain a Passive Evade granting 100% Chance to Evade the next Basic Attack for 8 seconds. After triggering an Evade this effect is removed. Evade does not trigger while holding block.
When triggering an Evade, Black Widow Counter-Attacks with a Flashbang. This attack cannot Miss and does not generate Power.

When triggering an Evade through any of Black Widows personal Evade abilities, inflict a Sabotage Debuff reducing Defensive Ability Accuracy by 20% for 6 seconds. Sabotage deals [211.18] Direct Damage whenever an Opponent's Defensive Abilities fail to trigger. This Defensive Ability Accuracy reduction does not stack with other Sabotage effects.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The last hit inflicts a Shock Debuff dealing [10,559] Energy Damage over 13 seconds.

At the end of this Special Attack gain a Passive Evade granting 100% chance to Evade any Basic Attack for 6 seconds. After triggering this Evade the effect is removed. Evade will not trigger while Blocking.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Inflict an instant Shock, dealing [20,062.1] Energy Damage when striking Shocked Opponents.
If Widow's Insight is active: All hits reduce Defensive Ability Accuracy by 70%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict a Sabotage Debuff reducing Defensive Ability Accuracy by 20% for 16 seconds and dealing [211.18] Direct damage when the Opponent's Defensive Abilities fails to trigger. This Defensive Ability Accuracy reduction does not stack with other Sabotage effects.

For every 5 stacks of Widows Insight gained since last activating this Special Attack, create a Passive Cruelty increasing Critical Damage Rating by [563.25] for 30 seconds. Widow's Insight is reset to 0 after launching this Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Red Room Training
content: Increase the potency of Sabotage Debuffs, increasing Direct damage done when abilities fail to trigger by [40 - 120%].
Increase the duration of Sabotage Debuffs by [10 - 80%].
Landing hits while Widow's Insight is active pauses Sabotage Debuffs for 0.5 seconds.
